headline: Datadog considers $4 billion buyout of cloud security firm Upwind
summary: Observability platform Datadog is evaluating a $4 billion takeover offer for cybersecurity startup Upwind. Upwind is simultaneously considering a $300 million venture funding offer from Bessemer Venture Partners.
why: Datadog develops cloud monitoring, analytics, and infrastructure security software.

impacts.name: Datadog Inc.
impacts.why: Acquiring Upwind would expand Datadog's cybersecurity footprint while requiring significant expenditure.
